title: Scout a Ɔwɔ Nhama
intro: Wɔ ahenni bi a obi a wɔama no tumi wɔ mframa, abɔde a wonhu, ne wim abɔde so di so mu no, ɔmannifo ketewaa biako a ɔyɛ ntɛmntɛm yera fii kuw no mu — na ɔsan bae de adiyisɛm ahorow a ɛbɛsan asiesie ɔman bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri nkrabea. Saa amanneɛbɔfo a n’ani da hɔ yi de nokware baa hann mu wɔ baabi a na nimdeɛ a wonni agye ntini no. Meyɛ Henanom?
clues: Mesom wɔ asɛnnibea bi a nnipa, abɔde a wonhu wɔn, ne wim abɔde bua sodifo nyansafo biako pɛ a ɔhyɛ mframa ankasa.
Na minni m’adwuma no mu bere bi, na wɔhyɛɛ sodifo no abufuw bɔ sɛ sɛ mantumi amfa ntease a ɛma abotɔyam amma a.
Meyɛ abɔdeɛ ketewa bi a ɔtu, a wonim me sɛ mehu ade nnam, na wɔde din a wɔbɔɔ tẽẽ wɔ adiyisɛm nkratafa mu hyɛɛ me su no anuonyam.
Bere a mesan bae no, mede asase bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a nkurɔfo no kotow owia, a wɔn ani afura wɔ Nea ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne asase no ho amanneɛbɔ bae.
Mihuu ɔbea bi a odi ahenni kɛse bi so, na ɔte ahengua a ɛyɛ nwonwa so, a onnim nokware no da.
Me ne deɛ mehunuu Saba’ ahemman no na mekuraa nsato krataa a ɛfiri odiyifoɔ-hene bi a wɔmaa no mframa so tumi.

options: Nwansena a ofi Sulaiman Bon mu

outcome.answer: Bilqis baa Sulaiman asennibea a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu

arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verse: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars. (27:27)
